# Number Field

Preserve exact decimal input while validating or evaluating text drafts.

## Usage

### Exact decimal

Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion.

<ComponentExample component="number-field" scenario="exact-decimal" title="Exact decimal" description="Enter 0.1 as decimal text and preserve it without binary floating-point coercion." :index="0" />

### Calculator

Enter 50-20% and commit the calculated result as 40.

<ComponentExample component="number-field" scenario="calculator" title="Calculator" description="Enter 50-20% and commit the calculated result as 40." :index="1" />

### Exponent

Enter 2^3^2 and evaluate exponentiation from right to left.

<ComponentExample component="number-field" scenario="exponent" title="Exponent" description="Enter 2^3^2 and evaluate exponentiation from right to left." :index="2" />

### Bounded

Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum.

<ComponentExample component="number-field" scenario="bounded" title="Bounded" description="Reject values outside the configured minimum and maximum." :index="3" />

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Standard editing keys</kbd> | Edit and select text with the host input conventions. |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> | Commit focus movement without replacing native text behavior. |

## Accessibility

The labeled input preserves native editing and exposes invalid, disabled, and readonly state.
